title: [two-device] Two-device users that interoperate with mls-rs
description: Promised to Rohan Mahy and Konrad Kohbrok in Mark's email of 2026-11-18 (IETF notes/2026-11-18-mimid-interop-answers-sent.md). Before the interop day. Stock mls-rs rejects two leaves with the same BasicCredential identity, so a mimid user with two devices can't share a group with an mls-rs client. Mark chose BOTH fixes (2026-11-18), as the two children.
notes: Listed as a hard blocker in Mark's mandated-interop analysis, 2026-11-22 (epic mimid-7yn7): every gatekeeper is multi-device, MLS models it as several clients per user, so this is max_clients and multi_device plus KeyPackage supply under real load. Already P1.
